title: Glycerol Stocks Preparation
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8e3htgn

steps.title: Grow overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 3 mL of the appropriate medium with antibiotic and incubate overnight: use low‑salt LB for E. coli and YPD for Pichia.

steps.title: Prepare 80% glycerol solution
steps.instruction: Mix 20 mL sterile H₂O with 80 mL pure glycerol, then autoclave to sterilize.

steps.title: Mix E. coli cells with glycerol
steps.instruction: Combine 812 µL of the overnight E. coli culture with 188 µL of the sterile 80 % glycerol solution.

steps.title: Prepare Pichia cells for glycerol
steps.instruction: Process the Pichia overnight culture before glycerol addition.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture for 2 min at 2000 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the remaining liquid.
Mix 812 µL of this resuspended culture with 188 µL of sterile 80 % glycerol.

steps.title: Freeze stocks in cryovials
steps.instruction: Aliquot the cell‑glycerol mixtures into cryovials and store them at –80 °C.
